response.query: What rater training curriculum, exemplar library content, calibration cadence, and ICC/checkpoint thresholds will maintain fidelity and detect rater drift?
response.answer: Rater training should include a comprehensive curriculum, exemplar library, and regular calibration every 3-6 months. ICC thresholds should be set at 0.70 or higher to maintain fidelity and detect rater drift.
